auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: The authentication mode to use. Choose OAuth or a HubSpot private app token.

access_token.title: Private App Token
access_token.description: The access token of a HubSpot private app (Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > Auth tab). Used as a Bearer token.

oauth_credentials.title: Sign in with Hubspot

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: The client ID from the OAuth application used to authenticate the user.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: The client secret from the OAuth application used to authenticate the user.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained through Hubspot's OAuth flow from an account with Super Admin access.

oauth_credentials.description: Please use a Hubspot account with Super Admin access. Using an account with insufficient permissions will result in an error.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Records created or updated after the start date will be extracted from the source.

enable_leads_stream.title: Enable Leads stream
enable_leads_stream.description: Whether to enable Leads stream or not. Note you need to have Hubspot Pro or Enterprise for this to work.

object_name.title: Hubspot entity name
object_name.description: The Hubspot entity name you want to fetch associations for.

association_string.title: Associations (comma-separated list)
association_string.description: The object type name (e.g. 'deals', 'contacts', or a custom object ID like 2-12345).

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: Configure which associations to extract per object type (standard or custom). Each entry specifies an object name and a comma-separated list of associated entities. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_contact_property_history.title: Extract contact properties history
extract_contact_property_history.description: Enable the extraction of properties history for contacts. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_contact_property_history_comma_s.title: Contact properties history (comma separated)
extract_contact_property_history_comma_s.description: Comma separated list with the name of the properties that should be extracted, e.g.: "lifecyclestage, hs_lastmodifieddate".

extract_deal_property_history.title: Extract deal properties history
extract_deal_property_history.description: Enable the extraction of properties history for deals. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_deal_property_history_comma_sepa.title: Deal properties history (comma separated)
extract_deal_property_history_comma_sepa.description: Comma separated list with the name of the properties that should be extracted, e.g.: "dealstage, hs_lastmodifieddate".

extract_ticket_property_history.title: Extract ticket properties history
extract_ticket_property_history.description: Enable the extraction of properties history for tickets. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_ticket_property_history_comma_se.title: Ticket properties history (comma separated)
extract_ticket_property_history_comma_se.description: Comma separated list with the name of the properties that should be extracted, e.g.: "hs_pipeline_stage, hs_ticket_priority".

extract_company_property_history.title: Extract company properties history
extract_company_property_history.description: Enable the extraction of properties history for companies. Enable only if necessary, since it significantly increases the extraction time.

extract_company_property_history_comma_s.title: Company properties history (comma separated)
extract_company_property_history_comma_s.description: Comma separated list with the name of the properties that should be extracted, e.g.: "name, domain".

property_objects.title: Property objects (comma separated)
property_objects.default: calls, communication, company, contacts, deals, email, line_item, meeting, notes, postal_mail, product, task, tickets
property_objects.description: Comma separated list of HubSpot object types to fetch property definitions for.

properties_as_json_string.title: Properties as JSON string
properties_as_json_string.description: When enabled, the 'properties' column is emitted as a JSON string instead of a structured object. Use this to work around destination limits on the number of nested fields (e.g. BigQuery's 10,000 field limit).
